summary: Iteration 7: checked the live Claude drafts and the Exa competitor flows. (1) Guest demo Beta Corp Send PASS. draft-loading showed first, then a real Claude draft (anthropic.draft ok in 2.0s). It is addressed To ceo@betacorp.example.com, Cc ops@betacorp.example.com. Body: 'Hi Sam, Tier 2 is [price] annually...' signed 'Stripe'. The price is a placeholder and there is no '[Template draft' text. Send gave the toast 'Demo: marked as sent (no real email went out)', the modal closed and the Beta card was removed. (2) Founder Connections: the first attempt FAILED. Find returned 200 [] and no chips or toast appeared. RCA: 'wiki' in AGGREGATORS was sent to Exa excludeDomains, so all 3 Exa calls (findSimilar plus 2 searches) returned 400 INVALID_DOMAIN 'Domain must include a top-level domain: wiki'. find_candidates swallows the errors, so the endpoint returned an empty 200. I fixed it in market.py with EXA_EXCLUDE (only entries that contain a dot go to Exa; the substring filter still uses AGGREGATORS). After the fix: 10 chips, no github/dev.to/wiki domains. Clicking the accounts-os.com chip confirmed it and showed 'Invoicing · overlap 0.449'. Gmail Connect shows the toast 'Starting the Google connection failed. 401 Invalid API key: ck_**Vumy' and the page does not crash. Restored to mode-manual (card active, toast 'Back to your typed list'). (3) Guest voice call PASS: it connected (LIVE, timer running) and opened with 'Reply to Sam at Beta Corp before your Beta Corp renewal in 3 hours...'. End call shows 'Call ended.'

critical.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: 'wiki' in excludeDomains made every Exa call fail with 400, and the endpoint silently returned []

minor.issue: When every Exa call fails, find_candidates returns [] and the endpoint returns 200. It should return 424 with the Exa error so the UI can show a toast. Right now the user sees nothing.

Result quality for Lumen Labs (lumen.dev, 'Invoicing that chases late payers'): only accounts-os.com and invoiced.com look like real competitors. The rest are name matches: whoxy.com (a whois page for lumen.dev), p.rst.im (titled 'GitHub', a GitHub mirror), developer.lumen.com (telecom), lumen5.org, lumenjs.dev, getlumen.app, mylumen.io, zff.dev. Suggestions: drop results whose title contains GitHub or Whois, drop whois/lookup sites, and drop domains that share only the founder's brand token. Consider relying more on the one-liner searches than on findSimilar of a site that may not be the founder's.

issues: Chip names come from raw page titles (e.g. 'Invoicing', 'Invoiced: Accounts Receivable Automation Software', 'Lumen.dev [Whois Lookup & Whois History]'). A short brand name, or the domain, would read better.
The overlap value is a raw 3-decimal number (0.449). Consider a percentage or a low/med/high label.

action_items: Keep the EXA_EXCLUDE fix in advisor/market.py (entries without a TLD must not be sent to Exa excludeDomains)
Make /competitors/find return 424 when every Exa call failed instead of an empty 200
Filter out junk competitor candidates (whois, GitHub mirrors, brand-name-only matches)
critical_code_review_comments: market.find_candidates uses `except Exception: continue` and drops every Exa error with no log or surfaced error. That is why this bug was invisible. At least re-raise when all calls fail.
Claude draft: 'Tier 2 is [price] annually' adds a billing period ('annually') that is not in the thread. It is minor, but the prompt could also ask for the billing period as a placeholder.

success_rate.backend: 100% after fix (draft, send, find, confirm/rate, google connect error)

seed_data_creation: Two guest sessions. The founder now has 10 competitor docs (accounts-os.com confirmed, beta 0.449). The founder was restored to manual mode.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the db.call_log collection (name/ok/error) to see failures of external calls. Anthropic and Exa are real; Composio returns 401. Live checks are on /connections after mode-live; restore with mode-manual.
rca of the issue: Repro: as the founder in live mode, click find-competitors-button. Nothing appears. call_log shows exa.findSimilar and exa.search failing with 400 INVALID_DOMAIN 'wiki'. Cause: AGGREGATORS (used both as a substring filter and as Exa excludeDomains) contains 'wiki'. Mitigation applied: EXA_EXCLUDE = [a for a in AGGREGATORS if '.' in a] is used for excludeDomains.
